description: Process 360/spherical videos (.zip, .mov, .mp4) into 3D Gaussian splat environments.
inputInstructions: Use for 360/spherical captures of full environments; the template enables the spherical-camera reconstruction path. The defaults run camera reconstruction and splat training over the input capture, which is what a new capture needs. "Run camera reconstruction" and "Run splat training" resume or export from a previous run's archive instead, and both require that archive in the input. "Crop output bounds" trims the exported splat to the scene bounds, and "Crop mode" selects how the bounds are computed. Training uses the splatfacto-mcmc model, and "Maximum number of Gaussians" caps how many Gaussians it keeps, which bounds the GPU memory a run needs.

tagSchema.label: Run camera reconstruction
tagSchema.description: Recover camera poses from the input capture before training. Clear it to reuse poses already computed by an earlier run, which requires that run's COLMAP reconstruction archive or model archive in the input.

tagSchema.label: Run splat training
tagSchema.description: Train the Gaussian splat model. Clear it to export from an already-trained model, which requires that model's archive (model.tar.gz) in the input; on a fresh capture there is nothing to export and the run fails.

tagSchema.label: Crop output bounds
tagSchema.description: Trim the exported splat to the reconstructed scene bounds, removing the sparse points that surround a capture.

tagSchema.label: Crop mode
tagSchema.description: How the crop bounds are computed when "Crop output bounds" is set. environment keeps the surrounding scene; rigid_body fits a tight box around a single object.

tagSchema.label: Maximum number of Gaussians
tagSchema.description: The most Gaussians the splatfacto-mcmc model keeps while it trains, which bounds the GPU memory a run needs. The default is sized for the pipeline's 24 GB GPUs. Lower it if a run fails because the GPU ran out of memory; raise it for more detail only on a GPU with more memory. It has no effect when the configuration names another MODEL.
